content.title: Know where to go
content.summary: A quick recall check on where to take shelter when a tornado warning comes.

sources.label: National Weather Service — Tornado Safety: During
National Weather Service — Understand Tornado Alerts

checkin.prompt: A tornado warning comes in for your area while you're home. Where does everyone go?

choices.label: An interior room on the lowest floor, away from windows
A room with big windows, so you can watch for it
Against an outside wall, near a door

checkin.remember: Go to an interior room on the lowest floor, away from windows.
checkin.fullerExplanation: Ready.gov says to stay away from windows, doors, and outside walls, and to watch out for flying debris. So the plan is an interior room on the lowest floor of a sturdy building, away from windows.
